response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years of experience, strong distributed-systems and low-latency work (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec), and clear leadership through mentoring, workshops, and open-source projects. However, the role is fundamentally a C++ platform-engineering position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments over a decade ago plus a university thesis project. He shows no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, message-broker/IoT protocol work (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA), IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, or Azure. His recent trajectory is squarely web/TypeScript/Node and AI tooling, which diverges from the core requirement. Strong engineer, wrong specialization.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems
13+ years across embedded, backend, web, and mobile stacks
Proven mentoring, teaching, and technical communication track record
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade stale
No IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity background
No IoT/automation protocol exposure (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA) or Azure

key_factors.factor: Missing industrial security and protocol expertise
Strong distributed-systems and performance engineering depth
